user.title: Connect DiyHome
user.description: Enter your DiyHome account credentials. If your device is on the local network, you can optionally enter its mDNS hostname (e.g. DIYHome_WT1_AABBCC.local) to enable direct LAN control.

zeroconf_confirm.title: DiyHome device found
zeroconf_confirm.description: A DiyHome device was found on your network ({hostname}). Enter your account credentials to connect it.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to DiyHome. Check your internet connection.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs.
error.no_uid: Device found but UID missing. Try updating the firmware.

abort.no_uid: Device found but UID missing. Update the firmware and try again.

create_entry.default: DiyHome connected successfully. Your devices are now available in Home Assistant.

init.title: DiyHome — LAN settings
init.description: Set the device hostname or IP to enable direct LAN control (sub-second latency). If you enter a plain IP address, the system will automatically convert it to a stable mDNS hostname so it keeps working even after a router reset.
